claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_size
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The 'reduce' effect's primary mechanic is a one-category size reduction. No v4 atom or EffectAtom variant covers creature size modification. transform_target (full polymorph) is too broad — this retains the original stat block and only shifts the size category.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain the 'reduce' effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell — The creature's size decreases one size category

claude_proposed_widenings.justification: DurationValue.amount is typed as number, but the potion's duration is '1d4 hours' — a random roll resolved at drink time. No existing DurationValue variant supports a dice-rolled amount.
